Why It Matters

Why Business Registration Matters

The legal structure you choose determines how much personal liability you carry, how you're taxed, how easily you can raise capital, and how much ongoing compliance you'll need to manage. Registering correctly from day one avoids costly restructuring later.

We guide founders through this decision based on their actual plans — not a one-size-fits-all recommendation — and then handle the paperwork end to end.

Compare Structures

How to Choose the Right Business Structure

👤

Solo & Low Risk

Proprietorship or Partnership suit solo founders and small teams comfortable with unlimited liability, wanting minimal compliance.

✅

Professional Services & Small Teams

LLP offers limited liability with lighter compliance than a company — well suited to consulting and professional practices.

🏢

Fundraising & Scale

Private Limited Company is preferred by investors and suits businesses planning to raise equity funding or scale a team.

How It Works

Our Registration Process

1. Structure Advisory

We discuss your business plans and recommend the most suitable structure.

2. Documentation

We collect and verify the required documents from you and any co-founders/partners.

3. Filing

We prepare and file the registration application with the relevant authority.

4. Certificate & Onboarding

Once approved, we help you open a bank account and set up initial compliance tracking.

After You Register

Post-Registration Compliance

  • PAN, TAN and bank account setup
  • GST registration, if applicable to your turnover or business type
  • Statutory registers and initial filings specific to your structure
  • Ongoing annual compliance tracking so nothing is missed
